Dodge stamina usage: -15%
Resistant (0.5x) vs. [[Frost]] }} '''Asksvin cloak''' is a craftable [[Cape]] piece available in [[Ashlands]]. It offers a -15% dodge stamina usage and the [[Wind run]] effect. Wind run increases running speed up to +25% and decreases running stamina usage down to -100% based on [[wind]] direction and wind strength. An alternative option for an Ashlands-tier cape is the [[Ashen Cape]] which offers more combat bonuses. {{See also|Wind Run}} ==Upgrade information== {| class="wikitable" !Quality !1 !2 !3 !4 !Total |- !Durability |1500 |1550 |1600 |1650 | |- !Armor |1 |2 |3 |4 | |- !Cost |6 [[Asksvin Hide]]

2 [[Morgen Sinew]] {{Upgrade station row|Galdr table|4|start=2|addcol=1}} |} Beyond quality 4, the Asksvin Cloak can be upgraded further at the [[Forge of Potential]] with a [[Flametal Protection Idol]]. == Notes == * The Wind run affect works similar to sailing ships. * Wind strength affects the speed boost. * Before patch 0.219.16, the Asksvin cloak had a -15% Run stamina usage, no dodge stamina reduction, the Wind run effect had a movement bonus up to +100% and no run stamina reduction. {{Armor}} [[ru:Плащ из шкуры пеплозавра]]
